6371.title: Cross-bundle long-press ownership is not shared
6371.rootCauseOneLine: Separate module copies keep separate WeakSets, so the outer menu misses the inner native-event claim and both long-press timers open menus.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — aligned with verified cause
prReviews.topFinding: Shares native-event ownership across bundles; branch and PR tests were not executed.

6371.proposedFix: Share native-event press ownership across bundle copies and retain the cross-module regression case; existing open PR #6372 prevents a duplicate fix.
6371.caveats: Reproduced twice at the production DOM/component boundary, not on physical iOS. Browser Automation could not start because this host has no Chrome/Chromium, so no screenshot is claimed.
